Module 5: Capstone Project

End-to-end project from definition to production launch with monitoringand deployment.

Project Definition

Start with a clear project brief. Define what success looks like, thekey features required, and the metrics that matter. This foundationguides all subsequent development decisions.

Agent Architecture

Design the complete agent hierarchy for your capstone project, includingprimary agents, sub-agents, and skill composition. Document agentprompts, tool access, and hand-off protocols.

Plugin Development

Build custom plugins and skills that extend Claude Code capabilitiesfor your project's specific needs. Develop reusable plugins: skillpackages, MCP server configurations, and custom hook libraries.

Deployment Pipeline

Configure Next.js for Vercel deployment. Set up environment variables,custom domains, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Enable monitoring,analytics, and quick rollback capabilities.

Monitoring and Observability

Set up error tracking, performance metrics, user analytics, and healthchecks. Integrate with Vercel observability tools and custom dashboardsfor real-time project insights.

Capstone Showcase

Document your complete journey from Module 1 fundamentals throughModule 5 capstone. Include architecture diagrams, code samples,token savings analytics, and deployment success metrics.
